title: A joint resolution providing for the reappointment of Barbara M. Barrett as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary: This joint resolution reappoints Barbara M. Barrett as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: Congress approved a resolution to reappoint Barbara M. Barrett to another term as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian Institution's governing board.
summary.what_it_does: The resolution renews Barbara M. Barrett's seat as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents, which oversees the Smithsonian Institution. Citizen regents are private individuals chosen to help guide the Smithsonian's museums and research centers. The summary does not describe any other changes to the Smithsonian or to the board's powers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 20, 2018.
